name: SWE-2 model announcement OG card by Cognition's SWE-2
description: A 1200×630 announcement card built almost entirely from one centered lockup on a near-black ground: a small kicker line sits above a huge tightly-tracked grotesque headline paired with a hexagonal logomark. Behind it, a faint white-on-black technical chart — ruler ticks, ruled horizontals and a fan of curves with tiny numerals and mirrored micro-labels — supplies depth without competing for attention. A subtle film-grain overlay and a strict black/white/gray palette make the giant type read as the only real subject.
